publicEntrypoints.selectionRationale: Project the native Web Request and Response contracts through safe Haxe views so Route Handlers retain platform compatibility while JSON decoding uses explicit unknown instead of Haxe 4.3.7 Dynamic.
Bind the App Router configuration and metadata contracts without importing the complete Pages Router-oriented root surface.
Cover the complete documented cache and revalidation entrypoint, with unstable aliases visibly classified instead of silently normalized.
Expose the complete documented App Router form component boundary and its closed props contract.
Expose every documented async request-header boundary while retaining Next's read-versus-mutation return types.
Bind the documented image component, loader contracts, static data, and pure props helper without exposing optimizer internals.
Cover the documented default component, its props, and link-status hook while leaving implementation helpers private.
Cover documented App Router hooks and non-returning navigation interrupts while excluding server-insertion and unstable error helpers.
Bind request, response, middleware and proxy boundaries plus documented helpers; ImageResponse remains the separate P2 next/og promise.
Expose only the route and server-runtime types needed at App Router boundaries; the wider legacy data-fetching surface stays native.
Expose the documented lazy component loader and its two user-authored option contracts, not internal loadable implementation types.
Start with representative variable and static Google loaders; adding another font remains an explicit reviewed allowlist change.
Expose the complete public local-font default loader while keeping its generated support types implementation-only.
Bind the documented default component and props while excluding client-loader lifecycle helpers that are not application APIs.
Offer only the nullable migration hook for mixed Pages and App Router components; this is not an endorsement of the legacy router.
Keep image generation as a separately reviewable breadth feature rather than silently promoting its server re-export to P0.
Expose the single documented reporting hook while its bundled metric declaration remains internal support rather than a NextJsHx promise.

excludedEntrypoints.reason: Experimental entrypoints require a separate opt-in, version-pinned review and cannot enter the stable allowlist by discovery.
The Pages Router singleton is not App Router core; native code remains the explicit compatibility escape hatch.
